trailhead.label: the eastern edge of St. Jakob in Defereggen, the board’s start

cautions: The Schwarzach is a fast, cold glacial river: keep your dog out of it.
Cattle grazing on the riverside meadows in summer: short lead, give the herd room.
Farm tracks and village lanes open to traffic.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
